question.text: 'Fit and Proper' criteria for Sponsor/Manager per Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008 includes:

answer.text: Integrity, reputation and character, financial competence, no history of restraint orders/convictions/wilful default

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.93), the Schedule II fit-and-proper test for the Sponsor/Manager covers integrity, reputation and character; absence of any restraint orders or convictions; financial competence based on net worth and solvency; and absence of any wilful-defaulter history. The Trap: Looking only at financial metrics, citizenship, or age misses the character, conduct, and regulatory-history components of the test. Note: The same fit-and-proper standard applies broadly to SEBI-registered intermediaries.
